title: Directed differentiation and long-term maintenance of epicardial cells from human pluripotent stem cells under fully defined conditions
markdown:
## Protocol: WNT-modulated differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into epicardial cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the WNT-modulated differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) into epicardial cells. The process involves reagent preparation, cardiac progenitor differentiation using CHIR99021 and IWP2 modulation, and subsequent pro-epicardial differentiation using further CHIR99021 treatment. Key critical steps include optimizing cell seeding density, precise timing of medium changes, and validating cell line authenticity.

### Materials/Reagents

DMEM, Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS), PBS, Formaldehyde (16%), MilliQ water, Methanol, BSA, DMSO, A83-01, bFGF, CHIR99021, Y27632, L-ascorbic acid, Advanced DMEM/F12, GlutaMAX, RPMI, B27 Supplement Minus Insulin, B27 Supplement, IWP2, IWP4, Hoechst 33342, SB431542, Corning Synthemax II-SC substrate, TGFβ1, Matrigel, Gelatin (2% and 0.1%), Triton X-100, Non-fat dry milk, Accutase, mTeSR1, E8 medium, LaSR basal medium, RPMI/Vc/Ins medium, RPMI20 medium.

### Equipment

Stericup filtration systems (500 ml, 250 ml), 50 ml conical tubes, 15 ml conical tubes, 12 ml conical tubes, P1000 pipette tips, Hemocytometer, 6-well plates, 12-well plates, 24-well plates, 96-well plates, Coverslips, Glass pipettes, Incubator (37°C, 5% CO2).

### Safety & Sterility

Perform all sterile procedures in a sterile environment or hood. Use caution when handling formaldehyde, methanol, and DMSO. Ensure cell lines are regularly checked for authenticity, normal karyotype, and mycoplasma infection. Matrigel lots must be qualified by BD Biosciences for hESC/iPSC culture as some lots do not support self-renewal.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-experiment Setup

1. In a sterile environment, mix 50 ml FBS with 450 ml DMEM. Filter the medium using a 500 ml Stericup filtration system. Store the prepared medium at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Add 62.5 μl of 16% formaldehyde to 1 ml PBS. Do not store this solution; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
3. Add 1 ml of 16% formaldehyde to 3 ml PBS. Do not store this solution; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
4. Add 5 ml MilliQ water to 45 ml pure methanol. Store the mixture at −20 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
5. Add 1 g BSA to 1000 ml PBS. Filter the solution using Stericup filtration systems. Store at 4 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
6. Add 2.37 ml DMSO to 10 mg A83-01. Aliquot the solution and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->
7. Add 1 ml sterile PBS to 25 μg bFGF. Aliquot the solution and store at −20 °C for up to 3 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S07 -->
8. Add 1.49 ml DMSO to 25 mg CHIR99021. Aliquot the solution and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S08 -->
9. In a sterile environment, mix 30 ml DMEM, 15 ml FBS, 5 ml DMSO, and 50 μl Y27632. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S09 -->
10. In a sterile environment, mix 30 ml LaSR basal medium, 15 ml FBS, 5 ml DMSO, 2.5 μl A83-01, and 50 μl Y27632. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S10 -->
11. In a sterile environment, add 50 ml sterile MilliQ water to 5 g L-ascorbic acid. Aliquot into 1 ml samples and store at −20°C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S11 -->
12. In a sterile environment, mix 500 ml advanced DMEM/F12 medium, 6.5 mL GlutaMAX, and 500 μl of the 100 mg/ml ascorbic acid solution. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S12 -->
13. Add 2 μl of 36 mM CHIR99021 to 24 ml LaSR basal medium. Do not store this medium; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S13 -->
14. In a sterile environment, mix 500 ml RPMI and 10 ml B27 supplement Minus Insulin. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 1 month. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S14 -->
15. In a sterile environment, mix 500 ml RPMI and 10 ml B27 supplement. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 1 month. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S15 -->
16. In a sterile environment, mix 200 ml RPMI and 50 ml FBS. Filter through a 250 ml Stericup filtration system. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 1 month. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S16 -->
17. In a sterile environment, mix 500 ml RPMI, 1 ml of 100 mg/ml L-ascorbic acid, and 500 μl insulin solution. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S17 -->
18. Add 2 μl of 36 mM CHIR99021 to 24 ml RPMI/Vc/Ins medium. Do not store this medium; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S18 -->
19. Add 4.28 ml DMSO to 10 mg IWP2. Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 10 min to dissolve the IWP2. Aliquot 100 μl samples into 1.5 ml tubes and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S19 -->
20. Add 0.805 ml DMSO to 2 mg IWP4. Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 10 min to dissolve the IWP4. Aliquot 100 μl samples into 1.5 ml tubes and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S20 -->
21. In a sterile environment, add 6.24 ml PBS to 10 mg Y27632. Aliquot 100 μl samples into 1.5 ml tubes and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S21 -->
22. Add 50 μl of 5 mM Y27632 to 50 ml mTeSR1 (resulting in a final concentration of 5 μM Y27632). Store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S22 -->
23. Add 1.5 ml of 2% gelatin solution to 30 ml sterile MilliQ water. Do not store this solution; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S23 -->
24. Add 2.5 g BSA to 500 ml PBS. Filter using a 500 ml Stericup filtration system. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S24 -->
25. Add 5 ml Triton X-100 to 495 ml PBS. Shake the bottle to dissolve the Triton. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S25 -->
26. Add 2.5 g BSA and 50 ml of 1% Triton X-100 solution to 500 ml PBS. Filter using a 500 ml Stericup filtration system. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S26 -->
27. Add 5 ml Triton X-100 to 45 ml PBS. Shake the tube to dissolve the Triton. Store the medium at 4 °C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S27 -->
28. Add 0.5 g non-fat dry milk and 4 ml of 1% Triton X-100 solution to 6 ml PBS. Do not store this solution; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S28 -->
29. Add 2.5 μl of Hoechst 33342 stock solution (10 mg/ml) to 5 ml PBS. Do not store this solution; prepare fresh as needed. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S29 -->
30. Add 2.60 ml DMSO to 10 mg SB431542. Aliquot the solution and store at −20 °C for up to 1 year. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S30 -->
31. Add 10 ml of sterile water to the vial containing 10 mg Corning Synthemax II-SC substrate. Mix well to create a homogeneous 1 mg/ml stock solution. Store the solution at 4°C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S31 -->
32. Add 100 μl of sterile 4 mM HCl containing 0.1% bovine serum albumin to 2 μg TGFβ1. Aliquot the solution and store at −20 °C for up to 3 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S32 -->
33. Prepare Matrigel-coated plates: In a sterile hood, add 30 ml of cold (4 °C) DMEM/F12 to a 50 ml conical tube kept on ice. Thaw one Matrigel aliquot (2.5 mg) by adding 1 ml of cold DMEM/F12 and gently pipetting with a P1000 tip. Immediately transfer this to the 50 ml tube. Add 1 ml/well for 6-well plates, 0.5 ml/well for 12-well plates, 250 μl/well for 24-well plates, or 100 μl/well for 96-well plates. Allow to set for at least 30 minutes at room temperature. Store coated plates at 4 °C for up to 3 weeks. **CRITICAL:** Dissolve 0.5 mg Matrigel into 6 ml cold DMEM/F12. Use only Matrigel lots qualified by BD Biosciences, as some lots do not support hPSC self-renewal. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S33 -->
34. Prepare Synthemax-coated plates: In a sterile hood, add 6 ml of room temperature sterile water to a 12 ml conical tube. Add 150 μl of 1 mg/ml Synthemax II-SC stock solution and mix well. Add 1 ml/well for 6-well plates, 0.5 ml/well for 12-well plates, 250 μl/well for 24-well plates, or 100 μl/well for 96-well plates. Allow plates to sit at room temperature for at least 2 hours. Aspirate remaining solution. Plates are ready to use or can be stored at 4°C for up to 3 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S34 -->
35. Prepare gelatin-coated plates: In a sterile hood, add 30 ml of sterile water and 1.5 ml of 2% gelatin solution to a 50 ml conical tube. Mix well. Add 1 ml/well for 6-well plates, 0.5 ml/well for 12-well plates, 250 μl/well for 24-well plates, or 100 μl/well for 96-well plates. Allow to sit for at least 30 min at 37°C before use. Store coated plates at 4 °C for up to 3 weeks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S35 -->
36. Prepare gelatin-coated coverslips: Autoclave coverslips at 121°C, 15 psi for 30 minutes. Place one sterile coverslip in each well of a 12-well plate. Add 1 ml of 0.1% gelatin per well and incubate at 37 °C overnight. Store coated coverslips at 4 °C for up to 2 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S36 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CAUTION:** Regularly check cell lines to ensure they are authentic, have not acquired an abnormal karyotype, and are not infected with mycoplasma. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S37 -->

## Cardiac Progenitor Differentiation

### Day -3

1. Culture hPSCs on Matrigel- or Synthemax-coated 6-well plates in mTeSR1 or E8 medium to 80-90% confluence. Aspirate the medium and add 1 ml of room temperature Accutase to each well. Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 min. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Add 0.5 ml of mTeSR1 or E8 to each well of the 6-well plate. Pool all cells into a 15 ml conical tube. Mix well, count total cells with a hemocytometer, and centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
3. Aspirate supernatant. Resuspend cells in mTeSR1 or E8 + 5 μM Y27632 at a density of 2 million cells/ml. Plate 0.5 - 2.0 million cells/well in a 12-well Matrigel- or Synthemax-coated plate. Add medium to reach a final volume of 1 ml/well. This is Day -3. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CRITICAL STEP:** Seeding density is critical for efficient cardiac differentiation. Optimize initial plating density and expansion time for specific cell lines. We recommend plating 0.5 - 2.0 million cells per well of a 12-well plate and expanding for 3 days prior to differentiation initiation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->

### Day -2 and day -1

1. On Day -2 and Day -1, aspirate medium and replace with 2 ml room temperature mTeSR1 or E8 per well of the 12-well plate. For cells cultured in E8, pre-condition with 0.1-0.6 μM CHIR99021 on Day -1. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->

### Day 0

1. On Day 0, prepare RPMI medium containing 6 μM CHIR99021. Add 4 μl of 36 mM CHIR99021 to 24 ml RPMI basal medium. Aspirate old medium from wells and add 2 ml of the prepared RPMI/CHIR99021 medium to each well of the 12-well plate. Record the time. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CRITICAL STEP:** Record the time of finishing medium addition, as medium must be changed exactly 24 hours later. While 6 μM CHIR99021 is optimal for tested lines, other lines may vary. Lot-to-lot variability exists. Optimize concentration if necessary; we recommend testing 3-12 μM CHIR99021. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S02 -->

### Day 1

1. On Day 1, aspirate medium from each well of the 12-well plate and replace with 2 ml room temperature RPMI basal medium. Return plate to 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S01 -->

### Day 3

1. On Day 3 (72 hr post-CHIR99021), prepare combined medium: collect 1 ml medium from the 12-well plate and mix with 1 ml fresh RPMI basal medium in a 15 ml conical tube. Add 1 μl of 5 mM IWP2 (final conc. 2.5 μM) to the 2 ml combined medium. Gently rock the plate to suspend debris before aspiration. Aspirate remaining 1 ml medium from each well and add 2 ml/well of the combined medium containing IWP2. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T4-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CRITICAL STEP:** While 2.5 μM IWP2 is optimal for tested lines, optimization may be required for others. We recommend testing 2-8 μM IWP2. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T4-S02 -->

### Day 5

1. On Day 5, aspirate medium from each well of the 12-well plate and add 2 ml/well room temperature RPMI basal medium. Return plate to 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T5-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CRITICAL STEP:** Day 6 cells are optimal for epicardial generation, but Day 5 or 7 cells also efficiently generate WT1+ epicardial cells after 2 days of CHIR99021 treatment. If using Day 5 cells, do not change medium on Day 5; instead, singularize cells and seed according to Steps 9-12. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T5-S02 -->

## Pro-epicardial Differentiation

### Day 6

1. On Day 6, aspirate medium, add 1 ml Accutase per well in a 12-well plate, and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 min. For quick passage without centrifugation: aspirate Accutase, gently scrape cells into plating medium, and seed at a split ratio of 1:3 to 1:12. Otherwise, proceed to Step 10. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. Pipette 5-10 times with a P1000 tip to singularize cells. Transfer the 1 ml cell mixture into a 15 ml conical containing 2 ml RPMI20 medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. Count cells with a hemocytometer. Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min and aspirate supernatant. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->
4. Resuspend pellet in albumin-containing LaSR basal or albumin-free RPMI/Vc/Ins medium + 5 μM Y27632 at 100,000 cells/ml. Seed onto gelatin- or Synthemax-coated dish at 20,000 - 40,000 cells/cm² (1:6 to 1:12 split) in LaSR basal medium, or 40,000 - 80,000 cells/cm² (1:3-1:6 split) in RPMI/Vc/Ins medium. Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 overnight without medium change. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S04 -->

### Day 7 and day 8

1. On Day 7 and Day 8, aspirate medium and replace with 1 ml room temperature LaSR basal or RPMI/Vc/Ins medium + 3 μM CHIR99021 per well of the 12-well plate. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** **CRITICAL STEP:** While 3 μM CHIR99021 is optimal for tested lines, optimization may be required for others. We recommend testing 1-6 μM CHIR99021. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S02 -->

### Day 9, day 10, and day 11

1. On Day 9, Day 10, and Day 11, aspirate medium and replace with 1 ml room temperature LaSR basal or RPMI/Vc/Ins medium per well of the 12-well plate. On Day 12, >90% WT1+ cells can be collected for long-term maintenance, characterization, or further differentiation into fibroblasts and SMCs. Day 12 pro-epicardial cells can also be frozen for storage. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S01 -->
